paragraphs.text:
“No!”  Charlie  screams.  “The  Great Wind-Walker  comes!”  She 
grabs her rifle and levels it at you and the graduate students. 
Eyes wild, she backs toward the river.

“White men never understand,” she spits. “Go, then. Go with the 
Wind-Walker!” She runs to the ruined canoe, takes her personal 
pack, and dashes into the forest.

You shout after her, appealing to her professionalism. But 
she does not return.
To do your best to calm the frightened students, go to 95.
